player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaitakaro {player_id} i te Tic Tac Toe Wild.
I to wa, ka taea e koe te whakapanga o tetahi 'X' o tetahi 'O' ki tetahi poraka kore.
Ka wini koe ma te whakarite i nga tohu e toru o te mea kotahi (X o O) i te raro.
Ka taea e koe te wini ki tetahi tohu.
Whiriwhiri to neke ki te whakamahi i te whakapapa '[X 4]' ki te whakapanga X ki waenganui.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ahakoa te whakapapa o te neke. Whakamahia '[X 4]' o '[O 2]' whakapapa.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Nama pūtau hē: {cell}. Me tau ki waenganui i te 0 me te 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: He nekehanga hē. Kua nohoia kē te pūtau {cell} .

game_action.placed: Kaitakaro {player_id} i whakapanga i to tohu ({mark}) ki roto i te poraka {cell}

outcome.win: Ka wikitoria te kaitākaro {player_id} mā ngā {mark}s!
